parts.zh: M: 欢迎收听《商业纵横》
W: 人们常犯的一个错误
M: 但我们有些同事的职位比我们低
W: 重要的是不要低估你的同事
M: 现在我们很多人都认为努力工作会给别人留下好印象
W: 没错。我们应该避免为了表现出自己的投入
W: 是的，最好确保自己投入的是高质量的时间
M: 那么，在工作中帮助别人呢？你是否应该尽力超越自己的日常职责
W: 向那些需要帮助的人提供援助

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: How to run one's business successfully.
choices.zh: 如何成功经营自己的事业。

choices.text: How to make progress in one's career.
choices.zh: 如何在职业生涯中取得进步。

choices.text: Why few people can fully display their capabilities.
choices.zh: 为什么很少有人能够充分展现自己的能力。

choices.text: Why young people seldom get the expected promotion.
choices.zh: 为什么年轻人很少得到预期的晋升。

items.stem: What does the woman say is one mistake people make?

choices.text: To mix and interact with peers within the organization.
choices.zh: 在组织内与同辈交流互动。

choices.text: To restrict their connections exclusively to colleagues.
choices.zh: 将自己的交往范围仅限于同事。

choices.text: To limit communication only to their superiors.
choices.zh: 将交流仅限于上级。

choices.text: To underestimate their role in the company.
choices.zh: 低估自己在公司的作用。

items.stem: What does the woman advise people to do in their work?

choices.text: Put in quality time.
choices.zh: 投入高质量的时间。

choices.text: Connect with managers.
choices.zh: 与管理人员建立联系。

choices.text: Make greater efforts.
choices.zh: 付出更大的努力。

choices.text: Demonstrate final results.
choices.zh: 展示最终成果。

items.stem: Why does the man say one should not act like a know-it-all?

choices.text: To show their genius.
choices.zh: 为了展示自己的才智。

choices.text: To gain due respect.
choices.zh: 为了赢得应有的尊重。

choices.text: To guard against humiliation.
choices.zh: 为了避免受到羞辱。

choices.text: To avoid appearing arrogant.
choices.zh: 为了避免显得傲慢。

items.stem: What does the woman say they first need to do?

choices.text: Decide how to divide up the presentation tasks.
choices.zh: 决定如何分配演示任务。

choices.text: Investigate the available background research.
choices.zh: 调查现有的背景研究。

choices.text: Complete the project design together.
choices.zh: 共同完成项目设计。

choices.text: Find a suitable topic for their article.
choices.zh: 为他们的文章寻找一个合适的主题。

items.stem: Why does the man refuse to handle the background part?

choices.text: He wants to devote his time to other portions.
choices.zh: 他想把时间投入到其他部分。

choices.text: He believes the woman is better able to handle it.
choices.zh: 他认为这位女士更有能力处理这部分。

choices.text: He claims to have done most of the work already.
choices.zh: 他声称自己已经完成了大部分工作。

choices.text: He finds the woman more meticulous about details.
choices.zh: 他认为这位女士对细节更加仔细。

items.stem: What does the woman urge the man to stop doing?

choices.text: Questioning.
choices.zh: 提出质疑。

choices.text: Complaining.
choices.zh: 抱怨。

choices.text: Arguing.
choices.zh: 争论。

choices.text: Worrying.
choices.zh: 担心。

items.stem: Why does the man suggest he present the conclusion and the woman do the introduction?

choices.text: To avoid sounding monotonous to the listeners.
choices.zh: 为了避免让听众觉得单调乏味。

choices.text: To make the division of labor more reasonable.
choices.zh: 为了使分工更加合理。

choices.text: To keep himself from being overburdened.
choices.zh: 为了避免自己负担过重。

choices.text: To bring their capabilities fully into play.
choices.zh: 为了充分发挥他们各自的能力。

items.stem: What can makeup do according to new research from the University of Stirling in Scotland?

choices.text: Alter others' perceptions of the wearer.
choices.zh: 改变他人对化妆者的看法。

choices.text: Win others' admiration for the wearer.
choices.zh: 赢得他人对化妆者的赞赏。

choices.text: Enhance the wearer's confidence.
choices.zh: 增强化妆者的自信。

choices.text: Change the wearer's appearance.
choices.zh: 改变化妆者的外貌。

items.stem: How did both men and women rate the faces with cosmetics in the new research?

choices.text: As being a greater threat.
choices.zh: 认为这些面孔具有更大的威胁性。

choices.text: As being of higher prestige.
choices.zh: 认为这些面孔具有更高的声望。

choices.text: As being more dominant.
choices.zh: 认为这些面孔更具支配性。

choices.text: As being more attractive.
choices.zh: 认为这些面孔更有吸引力。

items.stem: Why does a female candidate need to know the gender of the hiring committee members?

choices.text: It might influence her way of introducing herself.
choices.zh: 这可能会影响她介绍自己的方式。

choices.text: It might impact her dressing style for the occasion.
choices.zh: 这可能会影响她为这一场合选择的着装风格。

choices.text: It might affect her decision on applying cosmetics.
choices.zh: 这可能会影响她是否使用化妆品的决定。

choices.text: It might sway her view on the interviewers' questions.
choices.zh: 这可能会左右她对面试官问题的看法。

items.stem: What methods do some advertisements trumpet about changing a habit?

choices.text: Those involving no self-recognition.
choices.zh: 不涉及自我认知的方法。

choices.text: Those forcing us to clench our teeth.
choices.zh: 迫使我们咬紧牙关的方法。

choices.text: Those resisting various temptations.
choices.zh: 抵制各种诱惑的方法。

choices.text: Those requiring no willpower at all.
choices.zh: 完全不需要意志力的方法。

items.stem: What does the speaker define willpower as?

choices.text: Regulating one's actions for the sake of good health.
choices.zh: 为了身体健康而调节自己的行为。

choices.text: Controlling one's actions with a motivating thought.
choices.zh: 用激励性的想法控制自己的行为。

choices.text: Using practical examples to guide one's behavior.
choices.zh: 用实际案例指导自己的行为。

choices.text: Denying oneself any comfort to prevent diseases.
choices.zh: 拒绝给自己任何舒适享受，以预防疾病。

items.stem: What may sound amazing enough as regards willpower?

choices.text: It equips us with an expert skill.
choices.zh: 它赋予我们一项专业技能。

choices.text: It exerts an enduring force on us.
choices.zh: 它对我们施加持久的力量。

choices.text: It leads to a burning goal.
choices.zh: 它促成一个强烈的目标。

choices.text: It begins with a bright idea.
choices.zh: 它始于一个绝妙的想法。

items.stem: What does the speaker say may make for effective willpower?

choices.text: Any cherished goal.
choices.zh: 任何珍视的目标。

choices.text: Any positive mindset.
choices.zh: 任何积极的心态。

choices.text: Any personal instinct.
choices.zh: 任何个人本能。

choices.text: Any valued role model.
choices.zh: 任何受重视的榜样。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the federal government's advice on seafood safety?

choices.text: It has long been criticized as unclear.
choices.zh: 长期以来一直被批评为表述不清。

choices.text: It has long been ignored by the public.
choices.zh: 长期以来一直被公众忽视。

choices.text: It has caused much panic among women.
choices.zh: 在女性中引发了极大的恐慌。

choices.text: It has resulted in different understandings.
choices.zh: 导致了不同的理解。

items.stem: What did the Food and Drug Administration do this week?

choices.text: It warned consumers not to eat fish from the Gulf of Mexico.
choices.zh: 警告消费者不要食用来自墨西哥湾的鱼。

choices.text: It called on expectant mothers to pay attention to food safety.
choices.zh: 呼吁孕妇关注食品安全。

choices.text: It issued an update to the advice on seafood consumption.
choices.zh: 发布了关于食用海产品建议的更新内容。

choices.text: It listed more than sixty species of fish as "choices to avoid".
choices.zh: 将六十多种鱼列为“应避免的选择”。

items.stem: According to the speaker, what are people concerned about regarding pregnant women and seafood?

choices.text: The impact of the FDA's analysis.
choices.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局分析的影响。

choices.text: Multiple factors including mercury.
choices.zh: 包括汞在内的多种因素。

choices.text: Critics' conclusions.
choices.zh: 批评者的结论。

choices.text: The prices of seafood.
choices.zh: 海产品的价格。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about people not taking any vacation?

choices.text: They will suffer a breakdown soon.
choices.zh: 他们很快就会崩溃。

choices.text: They will be losing both joy and life.
choices.zh: 他们会同时失去快乐和生活。

choices.text: They will be putting themselves and family at risk.
choices.zh: 他们会将自己和家人置于危险之中。

choices.text: They will make things worse for people around them.
choices.zh: 他们会让身边人的处境变得更糟。

items.stem: What does the 9-year study recommend people do when planning vacations?

choices.text: Spend 14 days for vacation every year.
choices.zh: 每年花14天度假。

choices.text: Aim for three separate vacations yearly.
choices.zh: 每年争取安排三次彼此分开的假期。

choices.text: Space out their vacations evenly instead of taking one long vacation.
choices.zh: 把假期均匀分散开来，而不是一次休一个长假。

choices.text: Use all their days off for a long summer break to achieve full-on calm.
choices.zh: 把所有休假日都用来享受一个漫长的暑假，以获得彻底的放松。

items.stem: Why is vacation frequency important according to the speaker?

choices.text: Expecting to have more vacations in a year will boost one's work efficiency.
choices.zh: 期待一年中有更多假期会提高一个人的工作效率。

choices.text: Anticipating more vacations would reduce one's feelings of despair at work.
choices.zh: 期待有更多假期会减轻一个人在工作中的绝望感。

choices.text: Taking more than three vacations yearly would prolong one's excitement.
choices.zh: 每年休假超过三次会延长一个人的兴奋感。

choices.text: Planning multiple breaks throughout the year will add to one's happiness.
choices.zh: 计划在一年中安排多次休息会增加一个人的幸福感。

items.stem: What are researchers doing in Sweden?

choices.text: Surveying when drivers are caught in the heat of arguments.
choices.zh: 调查驾驶员陷入激烈争论时的情况。

choices.text: Designing devices to prevent drivers from being distracted.
choices.zh: 设计防止驾驶员分心的设备。

choices.text: Testing models for monitoring drivers easily getting tired.
choices.zh: 测试用于监测容易疲劳驾驶员的模型。

choices.text: Developing sensor-based systems for autonomous vehicles.
choices.zh: 开发用于自动驾驶车辆的基于传感器的系统。

items.stem: What did the researchers' project aim to do according to Dr. Anna Anund?

choices.text: Make sure the autonomous vehicle operates in the simplest manner.
choices.zh: 确保自动驾驶车辆以最简便的方式运行。

choices.text: Ensure the transition from the driver to the vehicle is safely made.
choices.zh: 确保从驾驶员驾驶过渡到车辆驾驶能够安全完成。

choices.text: Alleviate the driver's pressure as much as possible.
choices.zh: 尽可能减轻驾驶员的压力。

choices.text: Record the driver's state as accurately as possible.
choices.zh: 尽可能准确地记录驾驶员的状态。

items.stem: What is thought to be responsible for a fifth of road accidents across the European Union?

choices.text: Driver fatigue.
choices.zh: 驾驶员疲劳。

choices.text: Dreadful traffic.
choices.zh: 糟糕的交通状况。

choices.text: Drunk driving.
choices.zh: 酒后驾车。

choices.text: Driving time.
choices.zh: 驾驶时间。

items.stem: Why do drivers now view self-driving cars as less safe than they used to?

choices.text: There has been a strong debate on the feasibility of Level 3 cars.
choices.zh: 围绕3级自动驾驶汽车的可行性展开了激烈争论。

choices.text: There have been few remarkable advances in auto technology.
choices.zh: 汽车技术方面鲜有显著进步。

choices.text: There has been a rise in attention-grabbing accidents recently.
choices.zh: 近期引人关注的事故有所增加。

choices.text: There have been few feasible ways to shift public sentiment.
choices.zh: 转变公众看法的可行方法很少。
